description: This file defines React components and column configurations for displaying model group information in a table, including formatting functions and UI rendering logic for a model hub dashboard.

methods.name: formatCost
methods.description: Formats a cost number to a dollar string with 4 decimal places, scaled by 1,000,000.

methods.name: formatTokens
methods.description: Formats token counts into a string with 'K' suffix if over 1000, or 'N/A' if undefined.

methods.name: formatLimits
methods.description: Generates a string representing RPM and TPM limits.
